scenarios.description: Simulates missing or unloadable O2 binary model artifact; must fail closed safely without crashing process or misclassifying threats as BENIGN.
scenarios.name: O2 ML Model Unavailable

scenarios.description: O2 binary detection is active and flags an attack, but O3 multiclass model is unavailable; must fall back to generic threat mitigation without crashing.
scenarios.name: O3 Classification Model Unavailable

scenarios.description: MySQL database is unreachable; core in-memory detection, WebSocket streaming, and simulated mitigation must continue operating safely while reporting degraded persistence.
scenarios.name: MySQL Persistence Unavailable

scenarios.description: Streaming client disconnects abruptly during active simulation and reconnects; server state must clean up connections, avoid event bursts, and resume streaming safely.
scenarios.name: WebSocket Client Disconnect & Reconnect

scenarios.description: Ingestion of truncated columns, non-numeric strings, and high-NaN vectors; must be rejected with 422 or fail-closed without server process crashes.
scenarios.name: Malformed and Incomplete Input Ingestion

scenarios.description: Volumetric traffic rates from 0 to 100,000 req/s on authentic benign and attack vectors; verifies deterministic policy output and guarantees benign traffic is never blocked.
scenarios.name: Extreme Traffic-Rate Boundary Surge

scenarios.description: Requests with expired tokens, tampered signatures, and missing authorization headers; must return 401 without protected telemetry/incident leakage.
scenarios.name: Invalid, Expired, and Tampered Authentication

scenarios.description: Mitigation engine invoked with invalid attack labels or missing telemetry metadata; must fall back to safe containment or reject safely.
scenarios.name: Mitigation Engine Invalid Input Handling
